== Source, printing and count verification (Story 386) ==
The Players Committee post linked in the article's Sources (WordPress post 34792) was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Schuman LS HITCO.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card identities displayed in the table. The download's File page attributes it to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The article contains 60 constructed cards and 30 outside-deck cards. The original download contains 60 constructed entries and 30 outside-deck entries. Its unchanged SHA-256 is <code>428babaa7065cc49aa3bafc8fdf64ebf89f5e1fa4d1298bd3808ee8c249f7fdf</code>. Constructed and outside-deck XML identities were checked separately; outside-deck vehicles and starships retain their own type groups.

* 1x [[Dagobah: Yoda's Hut (V) (ALT) (Errata 2)]]: XML <nowiki>216_26^</nowiki>. The explicit image modifier is represented by the matching published ALT face.
* 1x [[Wild Karrde (ALT) (Errata 3)]]: XML <nowiki>203_21^</nowiki>. The explicit image modifier is represented by the matching published ALT face.
